g.text: Paired final effects: selected formula versus current LAPA
Selected per held-out target: DNS=hybrid, MODBUS=route_sink, TLS=hybrid, SMB2=hybrid
95% Student-t intervals over 3 paired seed means (df=2), not packet-population confidence. Intervals are not clipped.
Formula choices were frozen before target inference; a negative result does not trigger reselection.
